text: In the MongoDB 8.0 process, an S collection lock blocks writes while remaining side writes are drained. A later X lock blocks reads and writes for final draining, constraint checks and commit. These phases are typically brief, but their duration depends on the remaining side writes. (high confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: Rebuilding an index under heavy write load can reduce write throughput and prolong the build. MongoDB recommends a window with reduced writes; the side-write mechanism does not promise disruption-free rebuilding. (medium confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: [redacted] records a drain-status hang without concurrent collection writes; the community thread reports other conditions with similar status text. The message alone does not establish a growing side-write backlog or a unique root cause. (medium confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: In simultaneous replica-set builds, nodes continue buffering and periodically draining side writes while awaiting the commit decision. Waiting at this stage can reflect commit coordination rather than unfinished collection scanning. (high confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: Hybrid index builds, introduced in MongoDB 4.2, combine a collection scan and sorted bulk loading with interception of concurrent writes into an internal storage-engine table. The 8.0 manual describes the corresponding temporary side-writes table and external-sorter stages. (high confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: In the hybrid path, inserts, updates and deletes still modify the collection. Their index-key changes are buffered for the index under construction from before scanning until completion; an update from a=1 to a=2 records deletion of key 1 and insertion of key 2. (low confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: The side-writes table drains in insertion order. An initial drain allows ongoing writes, so later drains must apply changes that arrived afterward; the table is removed only after remaining changes are applied. (high confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: A unique hybrid index build can temporarily encounter duplicate keys while writes continue. The build rechecks duplicates before committing and fails if violations persist; accepting writes during construction does not establish that the new unique index will succeed. (high confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: Xu Jing's production case describes MongoDB 4.2 writes stalling during bulk loading: an index builder's IX lock blocked a monitoring profile:-1 command requesting a database R lock, and queued writes then waited behind that request. This is a historical lock-queue interaction, not evidence that all hybrid builds block writes for their full duration. (low confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: SERVER-130777 reports that an array-producing side write after scanning, followed by clean shutdown before commit, can lose in-memory multikey metadata on resume and produce incorrect query results. Its 2026-10-12 update lists affected versions 6.0.0, 7.0.0 and 8.0.0, with no fix version; this is a ticket report, not a verified patch-release matrix. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-12)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: Percona's instrumented example includes drained-side-write log fields numApplied, totalInserted, totalDeleted and durationMillis. These describe drain activity; the same walkthrough shows commit-quorum messages as a separate step. (low confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: For MongoDB 8.0, heavy writes during an index build can reduce write performance and extend build time. The manual recommends considering a maintenance window with stopped or reduced application writes; allowing concurrent writes does not guarantee negligible operational impact. (low confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: Xu Jing reports a historical MongoDB 4.2 incident in which writes stopped for roughly five minutes during bulk loading. The investigation attributed the outage to a monitoring profile:-1 command waiting for a database shared lock behind the build, with subsequent writes queued behind that request. This is a version-scoped production report, not proof of the same behavior in current releases. (low confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds

text: The message "Index Build: draining writes received during build" does not by itself establish a heavy side-write backlog. [redacted] reports it on MongoDB 4.4.0 with four documents and no concurrent application activity; the ticket links a self-connectivity issue. Diagnose logs and replica-set coordination before attributing the message to write volume. (medium confidence)
keywords: Side-writes table and hybrid index builds
